question: Which of the following organisations regulates international trade?
solution:
The correct answer is __**WTO**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The World Trade Organization (WTO) is an intergovernmental organization that is concerned with the **regulation of international trade between nations.**
 
• The WTO o**fficially commenced on 1 January 1995** under the Marrakesh Agreement, signed by 123 nations on 15 April 1994, replacing the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT), **which commenced in 1948.**
 
• It is the **largest international economic organization in the world.**
 
• The World Trade Organization (WTO) is the only global international organization dealing with the rules of trade between nations.
